scope: Additional tooling conditions for retained live preflights 2 and 3 and the native duration pilot. No source, fixture or timing output is rewritten.
finding: Legacy runs the pinned SDK on Node 24.14.0 and prepends that directory to the supervised worker PATH. Native ShellTools fixes PATH to /usr/bin:/bin and the external verifier binds /usr/bin/node, currently Node 26.7.0. The original small JavaScript verifiers pass on both, but tool-process versions are not an identical performance condition.
implication: The observed 13% warm-task reduction is a whole-run observation, not an isolated Rust optimization or accepted equivalent-core benchmark. For subsequent matched repository work, use the absolute pinned Node runtime for the TS SDK while aligning child-tool PATH and external verifier executables with native.
